# Interoperability fixtures

`v3.hex` is a deterministic version-3 fixture. Its decoded SHA-256 is
`70feb12b392eb223c79db095aabb0500b64ba7f1ddf1a2f6030d29aa499466ca`.

It intentionally exercises header padding, vectors, sparse external IDs,
multiple node levels, empty upper-layer slots, flattened edges, and CRC-32.
